(Mm)Śūlapāṇi_Upādhyāya
a prolific Dharmaśāstra writer of Bengal a. the earlier stage of the Hindu revival in that part of the country of the Sāhudīya clan, a sub secton of the Bengal Rāḍiya Brāhmaṇas. Beg. of the 15th Cent.; quotes Kṛtyacintāmaṇi of Caṇḍeśvara (1300-1350 C.E.) an. his Śrāddhaviveka is commented by Śrīdhara (beg. of the 16th Cent..
Q. frequently by Raghunandana in his Tattvas, see JASB (NS). XI (1915) 372-73; in Prāyaścittakutūhala, RASB.

. ment. in Dvaitanirṇaya, see ABORI. III. (1922). p. 71.
